Legal.title: Terms and privacy
Legal.intro: Sawwiq showcases the work of social media agencies in Jordan. This page summarises how we use data and what each side is responsible for. The full legal version is under review.
Legal.s1: You don't need an account. We use an anonymous cookie to remember your likes, saves and follows on your device, and to count views once a day. We don't sell your data or use third-party ads.
Legal.s2: When you message an agency, we share your name, number and message with that agency only, with your explicit consent. Messages are kept for 24 months, then deleted.
Legal.s3: You are responsible for the accuracy of your page and for having the right to publish the work you show. Sponsored posts are always labelled "Sponsored". We may hide content that breaks these rules or suspend accounts.
Legal.s4: Under Jordan's Personal Data Protection Law No. 24 of 2023 you can ask to access, correct or delete your data, or withdraw consent. Write to privacy@sawwiq.jo.
Legal.s5: The platform is currently free for everyone. Any paid plans will be announced in advance and never charged without agreement.

doc.title: Service agreement
doc.partiesBody: This agreement is between {agency} ("the Agency"), listed on Sawwiq as @{handle}, and {client} ("the Client"), phone {phone}.
doc.noItems: As described in the milestones below.
doc.specialsBody: The Client's special requests below are part of the checklist of the milestone shown, and must be done for that milestone to be approved.
doc.paymentProtected: The Client pays each milestone's amount to Sawwiq before work on it starts. Sawwiq holds it and releases it to the Agency only after the Client confirms every checklist item of that milestone. If the Client doesn't respond, or the parties disagree, either may report a problem and Sawwiq decides, based on this agreement, the checklists and the history, whether to release or refund the held amount. A platform fee of {fee}% is deducted from each released amount.
doc.paymentDirect: The Client pays the Agency directly as the parties agree. Sawwiq records the agreement, checklists and confirmations but does not hold money and does not guarantee payment or delivery.
doc.changesBody: This agreement can't be changed after it is signed; the parties can cancel it and sign a new one. Either party may cancel while no money is held for it. Work already approved stays approved.
doc.ndaBody: Each party keeps confidential all non-public information it receives from the other in connection with this agreement (including business plans, prices, customer data, account passwords and unpublished content), uses it only to perform this agreement, and doesn't disclose it to anyone except those who need it for the work and are bound by the same duty. This continues for two years after the agreement ends. It doesn't cover information that is public, already known to the recipient, or that must be disclosed by law. The Agency may show published work in its portfolio unless the Client says otherwise in writing.
doc.generalBody: Electronic signatures on this agreement are binding under Jordan's Electronic Transactions Law. This agreement is governed by the laws of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. The parties will first try to settle disagreements through Sawwiq's dispute process.
doc.disclaimer: Standard template provided by Sawwiq for convenience; not legal advice.

All content, designs and source files belong to the client once paid for. When the contract ends or is cancelled, the agency hands over all access and files within seven days.

About.title: About Sawwiq
About.description: Sawwiq is a Jordanian platform to find, compare and hire marketing and social media agencies: how we verify agencies and reviews, and how protected payments work.
About.intro: Sawwiq is one place where business owners see the real work of marketing and social media agencies in Jordan, compare their prices and client reviews, then contact them directly or contract through the platform with protected payments.

what.title: What we offer
what.body: A page for every agency with its work and priced packages, hire pages for every service and city, an AI assistant that asks about your project and suggests the best-suited agencies with a realistic budget, and project requests where several agencies send you quotes.

verify.title: What "Verified" means
verify.body: We check an agency's commercial registration before giving it the badge. It confirms the agency is registered; it does not guarantee the quality of its work, which is why we show the work and the reviews so you can judge.

reviews.title: How we keep reviews real
reviews.body: Only a client the agency invited with a single-use link, or a client who contacted the agency through Sawwiq, can write a review. Reviews can't be bought and negative ones aren't removed; the agency can reply publicly.

payments.title: Protected payments
payments.body: When you contract through Sawwiq, the work is split into milestones with dates, amounts and a checklist of deliverables. The client pays each milestone into Sawwiq, and it is released to the agency only after the client confirms every item. If the two sides disagree, our team reviews the case and decides.

demo.title: Demo accounts
demo.body: During the pilot some agencies carry a "Demo" label. They are examples for trying the platform, not real agencies; they are removed as real agencies join and are kept out of search results.

money.title: How Sawwiq makes money
money.body: Browsing and contacting agencies is free for everyone, and we take no commission on direct deals. Later we may offer agencies subscriptions that give them priority placement; these are always clearly labelled and never change how reviews rank.

Contact.title: Contact Sawwiq
Contact.description: Get in touch with the Sawwiq team: report a problem or ask a question, list your agency, or make a privacy and personal data request.
Contact.intro: Pick what fits your request. We usually reply within one working day.

support.title: A question or a problem on the site
